scripts.migrate: cd backend && python -m alembic upgrade head
scripts.start: npm run db:up && npm run besu:up && npm run chain:wait && npm run contract:verify && npm run migrate && npm run app:stop && concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --app-dir backend" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:8000/health && npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.stop: npm run app:stop && npm run besu:down
scripts.test:live: cd backend && cross-env LEXCORP_LIVE_BESU=1 python -m pytest -q tests/test_besu_live.py
